environment: Node.js float64 math / bundled DE441 sample positions
limitations: Simplified IAU pole and rotation coefficients.
Earth IERS orientation, lunar libration, local rise/set and eclipses excluded.
No real GPU, mobile device or scientific certification.

checks.name: ten modeled axes are normalized and finite
Earth axis is about 23.44 degrees from ecliptic north
retrograde Venus and Uranus use negative spin rate
date orientation is repeatable and advances with UTC
unmodeled satellites and demo geometry do not claim date orientation
date observation returns valid lunar phase and solar declination
known March new moon has less illumination than April full moon
opposite solstices put subsolar latitude in opposite hemispheres
geometric moon illumination obeys phase-angle dot product
observation calculation leaves positions and radii unchanged
